visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with light brown hair, wearing glasses and a black t-shirt with a small chest logo, stands on an outdoor asphalt road next to a white car. He holds car keys and points at the camera with an expressive, energetic facial expression. The background features utility poles, green trees, and some residential buildings under an overcast sky. (2) The scene shifts to an indoor automotive showroom where a black Lamborghini is parked. The man stands beside the vehicle, gesturing towards its sleek front hood and headlights. The environment is well-lit with high ceilings and various other cars visible in the background. (3) The man crouches down to show a close-up of the car's rear wheel, pointing at the HRE rim and the worn texture of the tire. He is wearing dark cargo pants and beige sneakers. The ground is a mix of concrete and gravel. (4) The man stands at the rear of the vehicle, leaning on a large carbon-fiber wing spoiler. He uses hand gestures to emphasize its size and material while explaining its modification cost. Other vehicles like a red coupe and a blue hatchback are parked nearby. (5) The camera moves to a detailed shot of the car's interior, showing black Alcantara upholstery with diamond-patterned stitching, orange seatbelts, and carbon fiber trim on the dashboard and steering wheel. (6) The man sits in the driver's seat wearing dark sunglasses, holding up a remote control key to start the car. The lighting is natural coming from the open garage door. (7) A dynamic sequence shows the man driving the car on an outdoor road. He gestures with his hands while looking at the camera, showing excitement. Trees and fields blur past the window. (8) The final phase shows the car's speedometer and dashboard during the drive, with the man concluding his presentation and pointing towards the screen where price information is displayed.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio opens with a male speaker delivering a high-energy monologue in Mandarin. His voice is clear and projected, set against a rhythmic electronic background music track with a driving beat. Faint urban traffic noise provides a natural ambient layer. (2) A sharp mechanical click sound occurs as a car door is opened, followed by a shift in vocal reverb as the environment changes to an indoor space. A secondary male voice (cameraman) is heard laughing faintly in response to the speaker. (3) A sudden, high-intensity transient sound of a high-performance engine starting up dominates the mix. This is followed by a series of aggressive engine revving sounds with broad frequency bandwidth. The speaker’s voice rises in pitch and arousal during these events. (4) The audio continues with high-speed engine hum and wind resistance sounds during a driving sequence. The BGM remains active but is ducked under the dominant engine noise. The speaker's delivery becomes even faster and more energetic. (5) The final phase features the speaker concluding his pitch with a stable vocal tone. The engine sound fades into a low-level background rumble while the electronic BGM swells slightly to close the video.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as a promotional sales vlog for a used luxury sports car (Lamborghini). It aims to attract potential buyers by showcasing the car's exterior condition, high-end modifications (HRE wheels, carbon fiber kit), interior luxury, and raw engine performance through a test drive.
